notes: Chapter 2 opening (plan row 2.1). shots.for: Her name was Aenor / questions / pets, music, birthdays
shots.prompt: Painted 2D animation style, clean line art, soft cinematic light, vertical 9:16 frame, no text or lettering in the image. Lunar Land in cool greys, blues and white under soft white street lamps. Asara and Earth in warm, bright colors. Space always black, with sharp stars and a large blue Earth. Out on the grey moon plains in low gravity, @Aenor in her smooth pale Earth suit and a clear helmet shield bounds high off the ground mid-step, arms out, talking and smiling. A few steps behind her, @Allen in his scuffed grey Lunar suit walks stiffly, keeping his distance. Long black shadows, black sky with sharp stars, large blue Earth high in the sky.
